I've grown lots of different kinds of berries forever. They're very easy to grow and require little care such as watering or feeding. Sometimes all you need to do is remove spent canes in the spring. And how long ago was that?

These days, PSATs are given in 10th grade, SATs in 11th.  SATs may be retaken as many times as desired, until about January of senior year.

Source:  I was up to recently the testing coordinator at a NYC high school.

@Bijoun
It's all tied up in the pressure put on high schoolers.  Originally PSATs were the Practice SAT done as a junior, then SATs in Fall of senior year so you could apply to college in Spring.

Now many colleges have admissions due in Fall, or students want to apply for early acceptance. Univ of California deadline for regular admissions is Nov 30.  Many elite schools receive upwards of 50,000 applications, so need more time to sift through them all.
